name: ios-plugin
description: Native iOS stack provider (Swift/SwiftUI) for the Agentic SDLC marketplace. Registers the ios profile via stack.md (aspect: ios, priority 300); provides ios-architect (Sonnet/medium) plus convention skills for SwiftUI, MVVM + @Observable architecture, data (SwiftData/CoreData/URLSession) and NavigationStack. Host-capability aware: lint/format and xcodebuild only run on macOS; verification degrades gracefully on Linux/CI. Builds are CI-deferred.
